question.problem:
$$
{{[\begin{aligned}7 & -3 & -1 \\ 28 & -8 & -3 \\ -49 & 37 & 7\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{A}={{[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 \\ 4 & 1 & 0 \\ -7 & 4 & 1\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{L}\cdot {{[\begin{aligned}7 & -3 & -1 \\ 0 & 4 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & \boxed{}\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{U}.
$$

Consider the LU factorization of the matrix $A$ above. What is the value of ${u}_{33}$ in the matrix $U?$
question.worked_solution:
The matrix $U$ in the LU decomposition is obtained from the original matrix $A$ by row-reducing using Gaussian elementation. In particular, to make zeros below the main diagonal, we proceed as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}7 & -3 & -1 \\ 28 & -8 & -3 \\ -49 & 37 & 7\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+(-4){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}7 & -3 & -1 \\ 0 & 4 & 1 \\ -49 & 37 & 7\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+7{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}7 & -3 & -1 \\ 0 & 4 & 1 \\ 0 & 16 & 0\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-4){R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}7 & -3 & -1 \\ 0 & 4 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & -4\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, ${u}_{33}=-4.$
